essence: One should visualize the dancing lord of gods at the tip of the triangle.
One should utter the formula beginning with tāra, followed by obeisance, 'bhagavate', and the word 'varāha'.
The mantra declared for Varāha worship consists of the rāma and agni syllables.
Bhū and Śrī are to be worshipped on the left and right sides respectively, each with her own mantra.
One should pray, 'To the lord of food, grant my food.'
